story: High in the Northern reaches of Pakistan, rain and snowmelt begin a long, quiet journey through stone, gravel, and alluvial earth shaped over millennia.
This is the same land that once fed the great cities of the Indus Valley — a civilisation that understood water as the foundation of life and order.
Mountiva draws from these deep aquifers. The water has already been filtered by the land itself. We protect it, respect it, and bottle it with precision.
No imported myths. No borrowed purity. Just clear water from Northern Pakistan, brought forward with modern standards and an ancient sense of duty.
This is Mountiva. Purity you can trust.

hero.heading: The land does the filtering
hero.lede: Rain and snowmelt descend for years through stone, gravel and alluvial earth. We draw the water only after geology has finished its work.

journey.title: Collection at elevation
journey.text: Rain and snowmelt gather in the Northern reaches of Pakistan and begin to percolate downward through fractured rock.

journey.title: Slow descent
journey.text: Over years, the water moves through gravel and fine alluvial earth shaped over millennia. Suspended particles and microbial load are strained out.

journey.title: Mineral balance
journey.text: Calcium, magnesium and bicarbonate are acquired from the host rock, never added. The result is stable and consistent in character.

journey.title: Careful abstraction
journey.text: We draw from the deep aquifer at a controlled rate, then move the water to bottle with minimal handling.

stewardship: We protect the recharge area so the water that enters the ground stays clean.
We monitor and cap abstraction so the aquifer is not drawn down faster than it refills.
We keep the route from source to bottle short and sealed.
source.transparencyHeading: Why we describe the source in general terms
source.transparency: Mountiva names Northern Pakistan and the deep aquifer, but not exact wellheads or recharge coordinates. Publishing exact coordinates would help no one and could put the aquifer at risk. Wholesale partners under agreement receive the full technical dossier, including source water analysis.

faq.question: Where does Mountiva water come from?
faq.answer: From deep aquifers in the Northern reaches of Pakistan. Rain and snowmelt descend for years through stone, gravel and alluvial earth, and are filtered by the land before we draw them.

faq.question: Why don't you publish the exact source location?
faq.answer: We name Northern Pakistan and the deep aquifer, but not exact wellheads or recharge coordinates. Exact coordinates would not help a buyer and could expose the source. Wholesale partners under agreement receive the full technical dossier.

faq.question: Do you provide lab reports and certificates?
faq.answer: Yes. Every wholesale batch ships with a Certificate of Analysis, and third-party lab reports and certifications are available on request and verified at contract stage.

faq.question: What is the minimum order?
faq.answer: MOQs are set per format, from around 40 to 80 cases. Contracted accounts can order mixed-format pallets.

faq.question: Do you offer private label?
faq.answer: Yes. Your brand and artwork on Mountiva-filled bottles, from a minimum of roughly three containers per year, with a lead time of 8 to 12 weeks from artwork sign-off.
